privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Welcome to our Medical Dental Education Platform ("Platform", "we", "us", or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our educational testing and quiz application. We are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This policy applies to all users of our Platform, including medical and dental students, residents, practitioners, and educators.

blocks.heading: Personal Information
items: Name, email address, and phone number
Educational institution and program information
Professional credentials and certifications
Profile picture and bio (optional)

blocks.heading: Usage Data
items: Test scores, quiz results, and performance analytics
Study patterns, time spent on questions, and progress tracking
Device information, IP address, and browser type
Login times and activity logs

blocks.heading: Communication Data
items: Direct messages with other users (instructors, peers)
Forum posts, comments, and discussions
Customer support inquiries and feedback

blocks.heading: Your Privacy Rights
items: Access: Request access to your personal data and obtain a copy
Correction: Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete information
Deletion: Request deletion of your personal data, subject to legal requirements
Data Portability: Request a copy of your data in a structured, machine-readable format
Opt-Out: Opt out of marketing communications at any time

blocks.heading: Third-Party Services
items: Our Platform may contain links to third-party websites or integrate with third-party services
We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these external services
Please review the privacy policies of any third-party services before sharing your information

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.intro: The information provided on this Medical Dental Education Platform is for educational purposes only and should not be considered professional medical or dental advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Please read this disclaimer carefully before using our services.

blocks.heading: Important Notice
blocks.description: This platform is designed to support medical and dental education through practice tests, quizzes, and study materials. It is not intended to replace formal education, clinical training, or professional judgment.

blocks.heading: No Professional Advice
items: Content is intended for educational and exam preparation purposes only
Not a substitute for professional medical or dental consultation, diagnosis, or treatment
Always seek the advice of qualified healthcare professionals for medical conditions
Never disregard professional medical advice or delay seeking it based on information from this platform

blocks.heading: Educational Content
items: Questions, answers, and explanations are created for learning purposes
Content should be used as a study aid alongside official textbooks and coursework
Information reflects general medical and dental knowledge and may not cover all scenarios
Clinical practice standards and guidelines may vary by region and institution

blocks.heading: Accuracy of Information
items: We strive to keep content accurate, current, and up to date
We do not guarantee completeness, accuracy, or timeliness at all times
Medical and dental knowledge evolves constantly; guidelines and best practices may change
Users should verify information with current clinical guidelines and peer-reviewed sources

This includes direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages
Use of this platform is at your own risk
We make no warranties about the reliability or availability of the service

We do not endorse or assume responsibility for third-party content
External sites have their own terms and privacy policies
